cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Impossible Plan
cards.instruction: Get someone to formally approve a plan whose logic becomes stranger each time it is explained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need your venue approval to store Tuesday's rain in this cup. The wedding lawn must stay dry.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's why the cup is empty. Please don't fill it; the rain needs room before it learns to fall.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've another wedding Wednesday. What if the cup leaks overnight?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then approve the lid too. We'll line it with Thursday's drought. Don't substitute an ordinary seal; Wednesday's wedding depends on it.
